featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Khetan
featured_reviews.review_text:
JADC is excellent. We have availed their services several time and each time they have been nothing less than excellent.

Their technicians reach the customer at the designated time. Digital image of the X-ray and report are sent to the customer and the doctor via email within an hour or so. Hard copy of the X-ray report is delivered within a few hours.

Their technicians are highly skilled and experienced in operating portable X-ray equipment. This includes providing clear instructions for preparation before the scan, explaining the procedure thoroughly, and promptly communicating results.

Up-to-date equipment, image clarity, short scan times, are the reasons for significantly enhancing the quality and efficiency of the service and overall patient comfort. Providing prompt response and flexible scheduling to accommodate urgent requests is their forte.

They are a combination of technical expertise, efficiency, and excellent customer care. I highly recommend their services.
